answer:
`windowOf` (src/out_json.zig:89-94) returns null in these cases, checked in this order:

1. The budget `w` is 0 (line 90).
2. The event has no span (`ev.span orelse return null`, line 91).
3. The text already fits: `ev.text.len <= w` (line 92).
4. The span lies outside the text: `sp.end > ev.text.len` (line 93).
5. The emitted text is not the line itself: `ev.text` differs from `ev.line_bytes` (line 94). The doc comment says this rules out `--replace` and `-o` (lines 87-88). The `--replace` test at line 578-582 confirms it.

The caller, `emitLineEvent`, also skips `windowOf` and uses null when `max_columns` is not greater than 0 (line 154).

The doc comment (lines 85-88) states that the order of the checks is the contract.
